messages:
ryan_sales: handing off CrescentAI — high-touch trial likely to convert but several blocking asks. They want Dedicated + VPC, SAML SSO, audit logs, and predictable burst capacity. Sales heard a strong renewal conditional on cost improvement (they saw a 2x token-cost spike during eval).

ryan_sales: quick context: account started trial 2024-09-01, POC Maya Patel (maya@crescent.ai). Current: hosted API. Requested: dedicated pool, on-prem data residency options, SSO + audit logs, 13-month SLA. Finance needs a cost model before pilot sign-off.

ryan_sales: immediate asks -> CS to own onboarding/runway, Eng/Support to validate SSO + export timeline, Platform to provide sizing & estimate for dedicated burst. Owners: @marta_cs, @jamie_onboard, @anika_support, @ryan_sales. Deal doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/deals/CRES-241

marta_cs: thanks — taking point. I'll set kickoff with Maya. Tentative onboarding window 09/18-09/30. Need SAML metadata + list of required audit fields from them. I'll add this to the CS tracker and create the customer onboarding doc.

jamie_onboard: I can prep infra checklist and runbook. Need dedicated sizing numbers from platform and the SAML cert/IdP metadata from the customer.

anika_support: fyi we have an open issue w/ audit-log exporter in v1.3 where ~1/1000 logs drop under sustained high write. There's a patch branch ready. We can hotfix dedicated clusters but need a maintenance window. Workaround: enable buffered-export (low-risk).

marta_cs: action items (summary):
- @ryan_sales: get Maya to share IdP metadata + compliance contact info and copy CS.
- @platform-team (cc @anika_support): provide dedicated sizing + cost estimate by EOD Thu.
- @jamie_onboard: draft onboarding runbook by 09/12 with provisioning steps and rollback playbook.
I'll own the customer kickoff scheduling.

ryan_sales: :thumbsup: emailing Maya now and will copy Marta.

deploy-bot: ticket INF-5421 created: dedicated-sizing request -> assigned to platform-ops (link: https://tickets.redwood.ai/INF-5421).

anika_support: buffered-export snippet (apply to dedicated cluster to reduce drops):
```yaml
audit_export:
  mode: buffered
  buffer_size: 5000
  flush_interval_ms: 2000
```
This reduces drop rate significantly; I'll coordinate the patch timeline if platform wants a hotfix.

marta_cs: capturing customer feedback here: they asked for a cost vs quality comparison (Llama3 vs Redwood-quant models) for long-sequence generation. @research-ml — can we get a short eval or pointer?

jamie_onboard: I'll draft the initial timeline in the onboarding doc and link it in this thread once ready.

marta_cs: thanks everyone — I'll update CRM with renewal risk flag and keep this thread updated as folks report in. If platform or eng need anything else from sales, ping me.
